title: Lucas County EMA — Diversion and Resource Request

transcript.speaker: EMA Duty Desk
transcript.text: Lucas County EMA duty desk. We're on the line with the regional healthcare coalition and the Ohio Department of Health. They need a status update on Ottawa River Regional Medical Center. Can you confirm your current ambulance diversion status, your hospital occupancy, and what resources you need to sustain operations for the next 24 hours?

transcript.speaker: AOC
transcript.text: We are on full diversion for ambulances. Occupancy is 331 inpatients, and we have 14 new admissions recorded on paper since 05:40. We are operating under the EHR Downtime Procedures Annex (ORRMC-DT-ANX-2026) and are in full paper mode. We need loaner laptops and printers, paper forms, and additional clinical staff to cover extended downtime. We are requesting the regional healthcare coalition to pre-position transfer capacity in case this extends beyond 24 hours.

transcript.speaker: EMA Duty Desk
transcript.text: Understood. We will relay your status to the coalition and the Ohio Department of Health. We will begin mobilizing loaner equipment and staffing support. Confirm you will reassess for transfer readiness every two hours.

instructorNote: This inject tests the AOC's ability to provide accurate, concise status to external emergency management and initiate support requests. Watch for whether the AOC correctly cites the EHR Downtime Procedures Annex and requests resources via the regional healthcare coalition.
